title: Neuro-evolutionary stochastic architectures in gauge-covariant neural fields
summary: We extend our gauge-covariant stochastic neural-field framework by promoting architecture-level parameters to slow stochastic variables evolving in function space. Our effective theory is formulated in terms of classical commuting fields and provides symmetry-constrained diagnostics of marginality and finite-width effects through the maximal Lyapunov exponent, the amplification factor, and dressed spectral kernels.
